name: CaseGridChildFillCell
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-child-fill-cell" (grid-sizing). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: grid child stretching to its cell (CSS default; canvas FILL both axes)
